keyEvents.text: Goal! Kidderminster Harriers 1, Doncaster Rovers 0. Lewis Walker (Kidderminster Harriers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Kidderminster Harriers 2, Doncaster Rovers 0. Maz Kouhyar (Kidderminster Harriers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lewis Walker.
Goal! Kidderminster Harriers 3, Doncaster Rovers 0. David Davis (Kidderminster Harriers) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner.
Robbie Gotts (Doncaster Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alfie May (Doncaster Rovers) is shown the yellow card.
